description: Returns session lifecycle state — drives frontend routing to correct screen (REQ-SESSION-007/010/011/012/013)

responseFields.description: Session lifecycle state: active, pending_approval, pending_acknowledgement, fyers_required, fyers_dirty, fyers_dirty_admin, deactivated
Session expiry timestamp in ISO 8601 format
Whether step-up re-authentication is valid (admin only)
Step-up expiry timestamp (admin only, null when not valid)

notes: Fields under step_up are present only when the user is an admin. Non-admin users receive state + expires_at only.
